recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser pet simulator called Neon Plush Pet Simulator. Preserve a simple virtual-pet needs loop: the player starts a session, watches three meters decay while awake, taps the pet to raise bond, taps feed to fill a dish and send the pet to eat until the dish drains, taps play or the playfield to spawn a toy that the pet chases, and toggles sleep to recharge energy while blocking other actions. Present it as a satirical anime lo-fi neon city fairy garden with a yellow plush electric mascot named Pika-Plush, neon noodles, glow yarn, a sleep pod, soft anti-anxiety copy, mobile-readable glass HUD, procedural canvas scenery, and catalog-backed cozy audio/reaction media.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: browser canvas virtual pet needs-management toy.
- objective: keep the pet comfortable by feeding, petting, playing, and letting it sleep; there is no terminal win/loss state.
- input model: one-thumb pointer/touch on canvas plus three large HUD buttons for feed, play, and sleep.
- core loop: start session, stats decay while awake, feed raises hunger after walking to bowl, play raises love while draining energy, pet tap raises love instantly, sleep restores energy and blocks other care actions.
- fail/friction state: low stats are soft pressure only; sleep/night blocks feed/play/pet until wake or energy reaches 100.

## Protected mechanics
- Stat values remain 0-100 with passive hunger/love/energy decay while awake and energy recharge while sleeping.
- Canvas pet can be tapped via the same bounding-box style hit test to trigger petting.
- Non-pet canvas tap during day places a toy and sends the pet to it; button play spawns a random toy.
- Feed fills a bowl/noodle dish, moves the pet to it, and increases hunger while food amount drains.
- Sleep toggles night/rest mode, pauses ambience, restores energy, and blocks other care actions with feedback.
- Movement speed, simple target walking, bobbing, blink, squish, particles, and requestAnimationFrame loop semantics are preserved.

## Remixed target
Neon Plush Pet Simulator reframes the cat-care room as a satirical anime lo-fi neon fairy-garden city. The focal companion is Pika-Plush, a yellow plush mascot/main-character pet. Food becomes neon noodles, play becomes glow-yarn chasing, sleep becomes a lo-fi sleep pod, and HUD stats become snack, bond, and zen. Presentation changes are procedural canvas/CSS visuals, catalog-backed fonts/audio/GIF reactions, and mobile-first HUD polish while preserving the original care mechanics.
